description: Search for people to reach out to by job title, department, seniority, location and company details. Returns names, roles and companies, and a profile link for each person, but not contact details, which find_contact_details returns for a profile link. Uses one lookup credit for each page that has not been searched before.

company_domains.description: restrict to people at these companies, by each company's own domain such as acme.com

company_keywords.description: words describing the company's business, for example fintech or logistics

departments.description: departments: sales, marketing, engineering, finance, human_resources, information_technology, legal, operations, product_management, support and others

keywords.description: words that must appear in the person's profile; whole words only

locations.description: where the person is based: cities, states or countries

seniorities.description: seniority levels: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern

titles.description: job titles to look for, for example VP of Sales

name: search_prospects

credits_used.description: lookup credits this call used; 0 when the page had been searched before

crm.description: the name of the customer's connected CRM; absent when none is connected

crm_url.description: link to the person's record in the customer's CRM

email_status.description: whether an e-mail address is likely to be found: verified, guessed or unavailable

in_crm.description: true when this person has already been added to the customer's CRM through Add to CRM

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile; pass it to find_contact_details or add_person_to_crm

total_results.description: how many people match in all

title: Search for prospects
